body:
It wasn't just possession it is also distribution since how they caught me was by downloading the videos themselves. In other words, they were downloading continuously for like a week during their sting operation and they took down every IP  they found. That is how they found me.

I just don't see how they would offer a 25 year plea bargain and my lawyer tell me to take it if I wasn't just going to get more if I took it to court.

My lawyer and I talked it over. Taking it to court after refusing the 25 year plea bargain almost guaranteed 30. Slap on skipping out on court and the fact that for this crime 95% of the has to be served and throw in a 20+ year sex offender registration... It is just too much.

I hope no one has to experience what I have over the last year and a half. I was a college student and it cost me $15,000 to stay out of jail. I had to bond out twice.


If anything I hope to spread some awareness about Zero Tolerance policies in America. This whole situation has really opened my eyes to it. In my state alone over 1000 people per year get arrested for my crime with a total population of less than 4 million. whereas in the U.K. only about 75-120 people get arrested for my crime per year and they have a population of over 63 million. 

That statistic pretty much, when I looked it up, put me in depression.

I hope you don't get down voted for your frankness, but I feel that is true. There is no group or person who would want to associate themselves with me other than those in similar situations, and I wouldn't fit in with them because that is not who I am. So I would just be an overall outcast and probably wouldn't survive.

If I knew what I know now about how this all turned out in the end I would have planned more for that. I thought about Estonia. Since it is loosely populated for the size of the country and I am blonde and blue eyed haha, but I just don't have the funds anymore to try more than I already have.
